newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Easier European feeds start slow on strong dollar.
newsitem.headline: Easier European feeds start slow on strong dollar.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market started slow this morning with sellers offering South American soymeal pellets $3 to $8 lower following last night's lower Chicago soymeal futures close and a stronger dollar.
Most other products were offered $1 to $2 down on the back of the easier dollar. No trades were reported during the initial stages of the market.

"The stronger dollar discouraged many buyers from entering the market early despite the weaker seller prices. A weaker tone in CBOT's Project A also kept a lid on early dealings," one broker said.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
